description.value:
Traits Signal, auditory, emotion, fear, mental

When an enemy critically fails a saving throw against one of your spells, it becomes frightened 2, the result of a critical success on Demoralize. This requires no action and no check. A creature affected by this is temporarily immune to it for 10 minutes, exactly as it would be after you Demoralized it.

cinderfall.incomplete: Bucket 4: reacting to a *separate* item's (your spell's) crit-fail-against-a-target by auto-applying a condition, sourced from this feat's own passive. No trigger-listener rule element for "on crit fail against my other item, do X" was found in the 34-key inventory (P12).
